## Parental OpControl 0.17.29

- **New version layout.** The dashboard sidebar now shows one compact version card: **VERSION** and the BETA pill on the top line, the version in accent green, and the build date and short commit underneath. It does not wrap in the narrow sidebar, and the © line stays below.
- **About Version section.** The section header has **VERSION** and one BETA pill on the left and the GitHub release link on the right. An amber banner explains that the product is in beta. Server and devices now share one table: Component, Version, Status and Last seen.
- **Device status.** Each device row shows **Up to date** with a green check when it matches the latest release, or **Update available** in amber with a download icon otherwise, plus **(offline)** when it is not connected. Last seen reads Today, Yesterday or a date in the family time zone. On phone width the table becomes stacked cards.
- **Kid About.** My OpControl → About now has a Version card with one yellow BETA pill, a two-column grid for **This laptop** and **Server** showing version and date (no commit hash), and a friendly note that the app is still being built.
- Both dashboard themes, both kid themes, phone width and English/es-MX are covered.
